title: HSV-1 metabolic hijacking: Mechanisms to precision therapeutics.
snippet: Herpes Simplex Virus Type 1 (HSV-1) strategically reprograms host cell metabolism to fulfill its replicative needs and establish persistent infection. This hijacking extends across glucose, lipid, amino acid, and nucleotide pathways, diverting resources toward viral biosynthesis.
